text: The parents of Amelia, Bernard, Giles, Philip, Ursula, Stevie, and Arthur speak in low voices. Each knows a child who returned from an errand with a changed temper. A younger sibling, safely out of earshot, remembers the children reciting a mirror rhyme before they vanished from the manor.

options.label: Protect the frightened siblings while they talk
